scope: Theorem 3.1 (The smooth entropy bound with a remainder) of the manuscript “A sharp entropy bound and the simplex inequality for isotropic constants” (preprints/A-sharp-entropy-bound-and-the-simplex-inequality-for-isotropic-constants-October-5-2026/isotropic-simplex.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 101 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b6cb0115cd04d4eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let m ≥ 1 be an integer and let µ = e−V dy be a probability measure on Rm, where V ∈ C∞(Rm) and c−I ≤ D2V ≤ c+I for constants 0 < c− ≤ c+ < ∞. Choose the affine normalization of Proposition 2.3, and let A = q−1(J) be the resulting Gaussian transport matrix field, so EA = 0. Set Xr = E(xrA), Y = A − m X r=1 xrXr, B = m X r=1 X2 r . If λ1, . . . , λm are the eigenvalues of B, then 2h(µ) − 2m − log det Cov(µ) ≥ 1 500 E tr(Y 2 ) + 1 1000 m X i=1 ω(λi). (3.2) In particular, h(µ) ≥ m + 1 2 log det Cov(µ).
